shots.p: wide shot of curving sand dunes at dawn under a pale sky, reverent silence
closed ornate Quran stand in a sunlit mosque niche, soft beams of dust, dignity and wisdom
wide shot of heavens and earth in purposeful order, sun setting over sea and mountains, a sense of an appointed end
a man standing before a row of lifeless stone idols in a desert shrine, the idols cracked and powerless
close-up of a man pleading before a silent stone statue that cannot hear, dust and cobwebs, futility
toppled stone idols lying broken in sand under a stormy sky, abandoned and hostile
men in an old Meccan street waving hands dismissively, calling it magic, while a reciter's voice drifts from a doorway
medium shot of a group of skeptical men arguing in a courtyard at dusk, pointing accusingly
a humble man walking alone on a long ancient road, following the footprints of many who walked before
a learned elderly scholar from among the People of the Book nodding in recognition over an old scroll, while a proud man turns away
proud wealthy men laughing at poor believers walking to prayer, sneering expression
two old books on a wooden stand side by side in lamp light, one older one newer, continuity of guidance
a believer standing firmly on a straight mountain path at sunrise, calm face free of fear and sorrow
smiling believers walking into a lush garden with flowing streams, peaceful eternal mood
a pregnant woman in hijab resting a hand on her belly, then a grown man in his forties kissing his elderly mother's hand, gratitude
a grateful family seated together at sunset in a green garden, warm and forgiven
a rebellious young man shouting at his worried elderly parents who are praying for him, tense domestic scene
ruins of ancient vanished nations covered by sand under a dark sky, warning of loss
a staircase of stone terraces rising up a hillside, people standing on different levels, ranks according to deeds
a wealthy man who wasted his life at a lavish feast now sitting alone in an empty hall, regretful
wide shot of the sand dunes of al-Ahqaf in southern Arabia under a warning grey sky, a lonely town at the edge
arrogant tribesmen of an ancient desert town gesturing defiantly toward the sky, challenging the warning
a crowd of ancient desert townspeople ignoring a lone voice of warning, turning back to their idols
townspeople pointing joyfully at a huge dark cloud approaching their valley, mistaking it for rain, ominous wind
a violent windstorm sweeping across a desert valley leaving only empty stone dwellings standing, sand drifting through doorways
ancient grand stone towers and fortifications of a powerful vanished people, empty and silent in the wind
a Meccan traveler gazing at deserted ruins around Arabia, crumbling villages and fallen roofs
broken idols half buried in sand beside ruined temples, powerless and abandoned
a quiet valley near Mecca at night under a starry sky, a gentle wind, an unseen presence of listeners, hushed reverence
a starlit desert night, the dunes silver under the moon, a sense of a message spreading far beyond
a lone traveler kneeling to drink at a clear spring in the desert night, answering a call, relief
a fleeing fox trapped by a canyon wall with no escape, symbol of inability to escape
vast heavens over the earth, rain reviving a dead brown plain into green life
a group of defiant men now bowing their heads in silent admission before an immense red glowing horizon
a patient man sitting calmly on a rock under a sunset sky, steadfast while others jeer far away, an hourglass beside him
